description: A PHP source file for generating execution timeline statistics reports within the TestLink project. It includes functions for initializing report parameters, building spreadsheets, and dealing with report display and email configuration.

methods.name: buildMailCfg
methods.description: Constructs email configuration object with subject line including test project and plan names.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes the GUI object with test plan and project details, user access level, and URLs for actions.

methods.name: createSpreadsheet
methods.description: Creates and populates a spreadsheet report with execution timeline data, then triggers download.

methods.name: xlsStepOne
methods.description: Generates initial header and contextual information for the spreadsheet report.

methods.name: initLblSpreadsheet
methods.description: Initializes label array for spreadsheet headers.

methods.name: initStyleSpreadsheet
methods.description: Defines style configurations for the spreadsheet cells.

methods.name: setCellRangeSpreadsheet
methods.description: Generates an array of column identifiers (A, B, ..., Z, AA, AB, ...) for spreadsheet columns.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks whether the user has rights to access test plan metrics in given project context.
